Specify Maia City's intent {intent} on play ("{title}"). Read it with the maia-play MCP tool get_intent, then specify it with specify_intent: its goal (what is true when it is done, in a sentence), its scope (what changes, named by UUIDs, hashes or paths, and what stays as it is) and its checks, each ONE statement that passes or fails, checked by a test (a command that passes), a measure (a value and its range from a named tool) or a look (against a named reference), must or nice; every check decidable by someone who reads only the intent and the result. Every test and measure check carries its run: the exact command that decides it in avenBOX, from the repository's root, as written, nothing in it left to fill in (a test passes when it exits 0; a measure prints its value and exits 0 only in its range); in Prototype bun play/avenbox/intent.ts runs them all, and main runs them again once the work is merged. Then stop: an admin approves the spec before anything is built.
